|game_text=Jabba's Prize is a Light Side card and does not count towards your deck limit (but subtracts one from the number of cards you may place under your Starting Effect). Reveal to opponent when deploying your Starting Effect. For remainder of game, you may not deploy [Maintenance] ''Falcon''. ''Deploys only at start of game if Jabba's Prize is at Security Tower (replaces opponent's Jabba's Prize imprisoned in Security Tower); otherwise place out of play.'' May not be placed in Reserve Deck. Jabba's Prize is a persona of Corran Horn only while on table. If Jabba's Prize was just released or leaves table, place it out of play. While Jabba's Prize is at Audience Chamber, opponent's battle destiny draws there are +1.
|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E3 of [[Jabba's Prize]] (version 4 of 4); it is the current text. The image is the Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1261-67-front-master.png]]), which prints this text. Versions in date order: [[Jabba's Prize]] (original, release sheet of 4 September 2009); [[Jabba's Prize (Errata)]] (PC-E1, PC website card list, by 21 July 2012); [[Jabba's Prize (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2, Players Committee card image, uploaded 25 February 2013, the same words as the original); '''this page''' (PC-E3, Master List of 27 April 2013, the same words as the original, the current text).
* '''Original''' ([[Jabba's Prize]]): text as given in the first copy of the Virtual Block 6.1 (Reflections IV) release sheet (official text as of 4 September 2009)<ref name="sheet-6_1-first">Virtual Set 6: Reflections IV sheet, first copy ("Official text as of September 4, 2009"; attachment Block6WithRebelFleetV.pdf, [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1375528 Players Committee forum])</ref>: “Jabba's Prize is a Light Side card and does not count towards your deck limit (but subtracts one from the number of cards you may place under your Starting Effect). Reveal to opponent when deploying your Starting Effect. For remainder of game, you may not deploy [Maintenance] ''Falcon''. ''Deploys only at start of game if Jabba's Prize is at Security Tower (replaces opponent's Jabba's Prize imprisoned in Security Tower); otherwise place out of play.'' May not be placed in Reserve Deck. Jabba's Prize is a persona of Corran Horn only while on table. If Jabba's Prize was just released or leaves table, place it out of play. While Jabba's Prize is at Audience Chamber, opponent's battle destiny draws there are +1.” The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB6-65-Jabbas_Prize.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB6-L-jabbasprizefront-pre.gif]]) print it. The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013, Light Side p. 9) prints this text again; under the ruling of 11 November 2026 (every publication is a version), that copy is its own version, PC-E3 (this page), and the current text.<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=9, page 9. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=9 Internet Archive]</ref> The release-sheet slip prints the slip number “65” at the bottom right.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Jabba's Prize (Errata)]]): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and in every capture to 11 January 2013) changed “towards” to “toward” and “place under” to “start under”, moved “For remainder of game, you may not deploy [Maintenance] Falcon.” after “place it out of play.” and changed “Prize is at Audience Chamber” to “Prize at Audience Chamber” (the italic sentence is set in braces there; the back is unchanged, “Text: none”)<ref name="cl-1261_67-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock6Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064737/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive)</ref>: “Jabba's Prize is a Light Side card and does not count toward your deck limit (but subtracts one from the number of cards you may start under your Starting Effect). Reveal to opponent when deploying your Starting Effect. ''Deploys only at start of game if Jabba's Prize is at Security Tower (replaces opponent's Jabba's Prize imprisoned in Security Tower); otherwise place out of play.'' May not be placed in Reserve Deck. Jabba's Prize is a persona of Corran Horn only while on table. If Jabba's Prize was just released or leaves table, place it out of play. For remainder of game, you may not deploy [Maintenance] ''Falcon''. While Jabba's Prize at Audience Chamber, opponent's battle destiny draws there are +1.” No published card image shows this text; the image of that page is a CardMaker recreation of the front ([[:File:VB6-65-Jabbas_Prize-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]]). The card list was generated from the Players Committee's Holotable card data (research R7, 11 November 2026), so this wording is a transcription the PC published, not a separately announced errata; it is listed because it was published.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Jabba's Prize (Errata 2)]]): the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB6-L-jabbasprizefront-pre.gif]], [[:File:VB6-L-jabbasprizeback-pre.gif]]) prints the original release-sheet text ([[Jabba's Prize]]) again, word for word: “Jabba's Prize is a Light Side card and does not count towards your deck limit (but subtracts one from the number of cards you may place under your Starting Effect). Reveal to opponent when deploying your Starting Effect. For remainder of game, you may not deploy [Maintenance] ''Falcon''. ''Deploys only at start of game if Jabba's Prize is at Security Tower (replaces opponent's Jabba's Prize imprisoned in Security Tower); otherwise place out of play.'' May not be placed in Reserve Deck. Jabba's Prize is a persona of Corran Horn only while on table. If Jabba's Prize was just released or leaves table, place it out of play. While Jabba's Prize is at Audience Chamber, opponent's battle destiny draws there are +1.” The image is dated only by its upload to the Players Committee's server: the Apache listing of the Virtual6-Light card-image folder gives every file there the same time, 25 February 2013, 11:34<ref name="pcdir-Virtual6-Light">Players Committee server, [https://web.archive.org/web/20190818034714/https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual6-Light/large/?C=M;O=A directory listing of cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual6-Light/large/] sorted by date, as captured 18 August 2019 (Internet Archive)</ref>. That is a bulk upload date, so the image may have been made earlier; it is placed at that date (ruling of 11 November 2026: what was uploaded last counts as the last version). It is listed as a version because it was published (ruling of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat). The PC card image prints the slip number “65” at the bottom right, as the release-sheet slip does.
* '''PC-E3''' (this page): the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Light Side, p. 9)<ref name="ml-ls" /> prints the original release-sheet text ([[Jabba's Prize]]) again, word for word: “Jabba's Prize is a Light Side card and does not count towards your deck limit (but subtracts one from the number of cards you may place under your Starting Effect). Reveal to opponent when deploying your Starting Effect. For remainder of game, you may not deploy [Maintenance] ''Falcon''. ''Deploys only at start of game if Jabba's Prize is at Security Tower (replaces opponent's Jabba's Prize imprisoned in Security Tower); otherwise place out of play.'' May not be placed in Reserve Deck. Jabba's Prize is a persona of Corran Horn only while on table. If Jabba's Prize was just released or leaves table, place it out of play. While Jabba's Prize is at Audience Chamber, opponent's battle destiny draws there are +1.” It is listed as a version because it was published (ruling of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat of an earlier text), and, as the latest dated text, it is the current text. Its image is the Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1261-67-front-master.png]]). The Master List slip prints no slip number (the release-sheet slip and the PC card image print “65”).
